rooms.emptyDescription: Join a district or topic chat, or accept a tea match to open a private chat.
rooms.unverifiedTitle: Chats open once you are verified
rooms.unverifiedBody: District and topic chats are for verified mothers. Ask to be verified in your profile; a moderator will call you.

room.emptyDescription: You can start by saying hello. People here look after each other, and a moderator is always close by.
room.held: Your message is held for review. If you need help now, use Help or call a crisis number.
room.review: Your message will appear once a moderator has checked it. This keeps the chats free of spam.
